title: Ray Tracer Player Movement Config
description: TOML player movement tuning loaded by internal/sceneio.LoadPlayer.
$comment: Source of truth: internal/sceneio/player.go and camera.DefaultConfig in internal/camera/camera.go. Update when movement fields change.

movement.description: TOML table [movement]. All fields optional; omitted or zero values keep the built-in defaults from camera.DefaultConfig.

walk_speed.description: Horizontal movement speed in world units per frame tick. Default: 0.35.

eye_height.description: Standing camera height above the feet. Default: 1.6.

jump_velocity.description: Initial upward velocity when jumping. Default: 0.42.

gravity.description: Downward acceleration per tick while airborne. Default: 0.20.

collision_radius.description: Player capsule radius for wall collision. Default: 0.30.

step_height.description: Maximum vertical step the player can walk up without jumping. Default: 0.45.

sprint_multiplier.description: Walk speed scale while holding sprint (Shift). Default: 2.0.

crouch_eye_height.description: Eye height while fully crouched. Default: 0.8.

crouch_speed_multiplier.description: Walk speed scale while crouching. Default: 0.5.

double_jump_enabled.description: Allow one extra jump while airborne (release and press jump again mid-air). Default: false.
